# Protocol v1 lab checks (2026-11-07)

Verifies PROTOCOL_V1_2026-11-07.md section 11, A3-A7, plus the import-and-trim probe. Media: real short03 v4 takes
(dials_simple_00149/00161/00163/00167 and the C3 take audio). Every Astrid call ran through <lab>/bin/clean.sh with --project;
no key, no GPU, no `projects select`, nothing deleted. Probe projects left in the lab root: probe-a3, probe-a4, probe-a5, probe-a6,
probe-a6b, probe-a6c, probe-a6d (empty, import refused), probe-a7, probe-editable-*. INTEROP_LOG.md has one row per check.

| # | assumption | result | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| A3 | vo clip with app.astrid.words on its own sound track is editable alone | PASS | imports; `timelines words` lists "It's" 1.996-2.120 and "you." 2.120-2.500 [line-c3]; `edit --clip vo-c3 --trim-in 0.2` status accepted; words unchanged after; re-export keeps the words. <lab>/logs/protocol-v1/a3-trim.json |
| A4 | editorial.transcribe runs locally, no key | FAIL | it is OpenAI whisper-1 (`from openai import OpenAI`, `load_api_key`, pack secret OPENAI_API_KEY). Clean lab run failed closed before any network call: "secret OPENAI_API_KEY is not declared for action editorial.transcribe". <lab>/logs/protocol-v1/a4-task.json |
| A5 | one commit batch deletes a clip and adds one with the SAME id | FAIL | add-then-delete: "created identity is occupied"; delete-then-add on the deleted clip: "create-after requires one existing stable member"; delete-then-add after a neighbour: Runtime refuses "created identity was already reserved" (single-use ids per timeline history, commit.py:953/990). The different-id swap passes (c3 -> c3-r43bd9c31). <lab>/scripts/probe_a5_same_id.py, <lab>/logs/protocol-v1/a5-real-delete-add-after-c2.json, a5-real-others.json, a5-control-diffid.json |
| A6 | Astrid-restructured export has a readable placements/shots shape | FAIL (not obtained) | see A6 below. Saved only the flat export: <lab>/fixtures/protocol-v1/placements-shape-FLAT-export.json |
| A7 | manifest.json tolerates an extra `snap` block | PASS | validator ok (2 media, 2 clips); import ok; trim accepted. Astrid's re-export DROPS the block (manifest keys: astrid, elements, exported_at, format, media, name, theme, transcripts) but KEEPS generation.snap and app.astrid.words. <lab>/fixtures/protocol-v1/probe-a7-snap-block.astrid, probe-a7-reexport.astrid |
| probe | import-and-trim in one command | PASS (built) | <lab>/scripts/probe_editable.py ARCHIVE --project P: imports, trims one clip, commits, reads back, one JSON line, exit 0/1. ok on probe-a3 (plain+vo+words) and the flat film; fails on the jam archive with the exact cause (below) |

## A6 detail

1. Imported flat cut with the cut idiom (the jam: `app.astrid.cut` on 'plate' clips + `config.app.astrid.chapters`): ANY commit is refused, including `label_chapters`: "candidate.timing: invalid timing input: ''". Reproduced locally: `_timing_evaluators.evaluate` -> `lookup._cut_groups` -> `_internal('')` KeyError '' because parent-owned clips have shot_id ''. Same with a 3-clip cut-only archive (<lab>/fixtures/protocol-v1/probe-a6-cuts.astrid), so it is the cut idiom on parent clips, not the vo track.
2. Same idiom: a literal trim is refused by the native path: "clip.trim v1 does not support cut" (so the jam archive is NOT editable by trim). Without the idiom (plain, or vo/words) the trim works. The CLI also needs `--clip parent/clip:ID` on a 'plate' track: a bare id (c3) is read as a cut name ("no cut c3; cuts are not named in this timeline").
3. A flat film with no cut idiom: `timelines restructure --dry-run` says "not a chapter film: it needs at least two chapter labels" (plan() needs exactly one placement row AND >= 2 chapter runs); `timelines edit --add-cut` says "no cut is on screen".
4. A hand-written placed-shot archive (3 shots, placements + shots{payload,internal_timeline}, ids as 32-hex): passes validate_astrid_archive.py offline but `timelines import` fails "timeline import commit failed: internal runtime error" (no Runtime log found). <lab>/scripts/make_shots_archive.py, <lab>/fixtures/protocol-v1/probe-a6-shots.astrid.
5. What an export of the FLAT form looks like: timeline.json has keys base_parent, base_parent_payload, base_placements, parent, placements ([]), project_id, schema_version, shots ({}), source_mapping, timeline_id; i.e. a full authoring bundle, not the slim input shape. Clip fields written back: generation.snap, app.astrid.segment/text/words, `hold` added to trimmed picture clips.

## What it changes for the design

- A3: the vo/words idiom stays in v1 as written (on its own audio track, no cut idiom).
- A4: R3's fallback applies: words come from Snap's own local Whisper into the archive (`app.astrid.words` / transcripts); Astrid-side `editorial.transcribe` is not usable without an OpenAI key and must not be in the loop.
- A5: PR-G cannot be "reorder the existing batch". Same-id re-take needs a Runtime change (allow reuse of an id deleted in the same batch, or a `clip.replace-media` op that keeps the id) or the stop-gap of section 7.2 (c) (new id, record it in Snap's receipt, rewrite generation.snap) stays the v1 behaviour. Do not promise "cut id = clip id forever" for re-takes in v1.
- A6: do not write `cut` idioms (`app.astrid.cut`/chapters) or placements/shots into v1 archives: they make the import uneditable (trim refused) and uncommittable (timing compile). Shot text bindings must stay in generation.snap + app.astrid (the stated fallback); Q-A4 needs asking, with the KeyError '' and the placed-shot "internal runtime error" as the concrete reports.
- A7: the receipt may ride in manifest.json `snap` for Snap's own use, but Astrid drops it on export, so Snap's own receipt (snap/astrid.json) remains the source of truth, and clip-level generation.snap is the only thing that round-trips.
- Probe: S1's exporter gate can run probe_editable.py on every produced archive; it would have caught the jam's cut idiom.
- Left behind: pending (unretried) edits pc_8f106f0b876e and pc_ffff34f483ef on probe-a5, pc_5d84ed1954fb/pc_c23015d65ead on probe-a6, pc_32791e4b3215 on probe-a6c (from refused commits; not dropped).
